svg.title: RMR control panel packing study
svg.text: RMR control panel: packing study, 18 x 13 x 11 in
Two decks in a 2020 frame, both on 1/16 in aluminum plates: lower deck for 110 VAC and 24 V power, upper deck for drives and logic; acrylic walls. Scale 1:3.5 when printed at 100 %.
A Upper deck, seen from above
1/16 in aluminum plate on the mid ring; parts at true size
upper posts stand on the plate; mid ring (dashed) under it
upper plate 457 x 330, part of the upper module
duct 1/2 x 1 in: field signals, SSR outputs
duct 1 x 1 1/2 in: motor cables, driver 24 V
duct 1 x 1 1/2 in: back run, motor cables to the upper left grommet
B Lower deck, upper deck lifted off
1/16 in aluminum base plate, bonded to PE
bottom ring on the base plate
parts inside the bottom ring, 417 x 290 mm
duct 1/2 x 1 in: 24 V feeds and 0V returns
fan face to the right wall
C End view from the front
front rails left off; heights, DIN rails dark grey
65 mm over the drivers for the top-face wires
lid ring: off alone (4 screws) or with the upper module
D Side view from the left
left rails left off; nearer parts hide farther ones
Every part stands on a 7.5 mm DIN rail; parts
without DIN feet add a printed clip, 10 mm.
TB6600s stand on their 96 x 28 base, ears
88 apart across the rail, fins vertical. The
24 V PSU lies flat on a 215 x 115 face, its
fan face 23 mm from the right panel. The Mega
lies along its rail, USB jack to the front
grommet; the SSR sockets stand across their
base plate 1.6, lower bay 106, upper plate 1.6,
The lower left grommet sets the lower bay:
its 64 mm ring needs a 66 mm window between
the bottom and mid rings. K2 alone would set
Two modules, like a platform-framed house.
Lower: base plate, bottom ring and lower
posts; stages 3 and 4 run on it alone.
Upper: mid ring, upper plate, upper posts
and lid ring, built and wired on the bench,
then set on 4 studs in the lower posts that
locate the decks. Inter-deck wires cross on
6 mm between drivers for air. The PSU fan
blows into the vent in the lower right panel;
its slots wait for the fan's size. Five 50 mm
grommets: upper left at x 182 (field) and
x 390 (motors, at the back run's end), upper
front (USB, J11), upper right (a motor, the
tower), lower left (ODrive 24 V, Pi 5 V,
E-stop). Mains in at the back wall in line with
the 110 V rail; the 110 V door cable leaves
beside it by an M20 gland. Mains wall: sheet 5.
Sizes: along x across x high (mm)
TB6600 28 x 96 x 68, measured. From the
listings: K1 HC1-63 36 x 82 x 65; K2 BMC7-25U
uxcell bar 20 x 78 x 53; SSR 6.1 x 88 x 71
5 V PSU 76 x 76 x 32; 6 V 63 x 58 x 23; Mega
215 x 115 x 50, F0, end clamps, PE blocks,
shield clamp, Mega height. Heights add the rail.
conductor-mm as drawn (34,912 at the study's
78.6 bay), against 57,478 for the hand layout.
Each block centre is held to layout3b_build
.json; no box overlaps another, and no plate
slot lies over the mains (y 182 and up).
flat, every part at its real size.
Frame and plates: sheet 4. Measure dashed sizes.
